name: settlement
description: Cash and securities settlement instructions: one record per instruction (row).

fields.name: settlement_date
fields.description: Date the cash or securities settle (value date).

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the settlement currency, inferred from a symbol when not written.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Settlement (cash) amount; negative for outflows when the source signs it.

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Free-text comments or narrative attached to the instruction.

fields.name: portfolio
fields.description: Portfolio, fund or account the instruction belongs to.

fields.name: cash_purpose_code
fields.description: Purpose code of the cash movement (e.g. ISO 20022 purpose such as SECU, INTC, DIVD, FEES).

fields.name: transaction_type
fields.description: Type of transaction (e.g. BUY, SELL, DVP, RVP, FX, CASH IN, CASH OUT, DIVIDEND).

fields.name: security_id
fields.description: Security identifier: ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL or internal id; empty for pure cash movements.
